meta.subject: sub-004
notes: Single final auditory-inspired envelope per stimulus
Envelope is computed from ERB-spaced filterbank envelopes collapsed by averaging
Stimulus arrays are saved as 1D object-array trial lists
EEG arrays are saved as 2D object-array trial lists with shape (time, channels)
Single-talker model is optional because it can add substantial runtime.
resp_tt is not saved in predictions NPZ unless --save-resp is used, because it already exists in the input NPZ.
